title: Copyright 2022 The Domain-Agnostic Contrastive Representations for Learning from Label Pro
summary: Productization of SelfCLR-LLP, a domain-agnostic contrastive representation method for learning from label proportions, benchmarked against DLLP and supervised baselines on Criteo-Kaggle and MovieLens-1M. Target: privacy-friendly modeling for ad and recommendation customers who only see bag-level labels.
